00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000029.title: Style and voice
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000029.synopsis: Short paragraphs. Weather before people. Let objects carry the feeling. Never explain the island in dialogue.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000007.title: Bellwether Island
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000007.synopsis: An island whose geography follows memory. The places its residents forget begin to disappear.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000007.notes: Keep a consistent relationship between memory and the landscape.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000044.synopsis: The Manuscript folder deliberately mixes organising styles so you can see how each one behaves in the views.
